verdict.rationale: Workspace export with full history is a fair question for a work-management SaaS like Asana, but the evidence pack never documents an export feature or what one would include. The only nearby items are a generic REST API and third-party extraction and backup tools (Fivetran, Skyvia, Airbyte), and none of them say comments, attachments or audit trails are preserved. The single 'audit trail' mention concerns AI agent governance, not export.
